_comment: v1.11.0 follow-up - supply the standard editorial SUBSECTION numbers as bold `**n.**` markers, the way the app already supplies the bracketed chapter numbers. The Latin Library prints no subsections at all, so the boundaries come from a numbered edition: Perseus (CTS, phi0448) for the Bellum Gallicum and the Bellum Civile, and PHI/Packard (author 428) for the Bellum Alexandrinum, which Perseus does not carry. Not one word of either edition is copied into the app; only the position of the boundaries is taken. The Bellum Alexandrinum anchors are written out by hand because PHI marks the LINE a section starts on, not the word - each one below was read off the printed line and is quoted in the reference sheet.
